title: Smart Greenhouse & Automated Plant Microclimate
subtitle: IoT Microclimate & Soil Moisture Regulation with ESP8266 & OLED
description: An automated IoT plant care microclimate system based on the ESP8266 NodeMCU. Continually tracks soil hydration, ambient luminosity (LDR), and climate metrics (DHT22), automatically actuating irrigation pumps, exhaust cooling fans, and UV growth lamps with an SSD1306 OLED display.
